description.zh: 教授定标准、导师做到位的双团队交付流程，合格线 95 分。
description.en: A professor writes the rubric blind; a tutor meets it. 95 is the bar.

title.zh: judge-loop：教授定标准，导师做到位

description.zh: 给真实项目产出可交付成品。教授只读题目与素材、定 4–6 维评分标准（不看稿，决定上限）；导师按标准一次做到 95 分以上，可向教授问判据初衷；独立判分人复核后直接交付。不跑机械闸门，不写 final/ 目录。四条红线不看分数：数字编造、拿立场当事实、两份材料打架、答应做不到的。
description.en: Two teams, one deliverable. A professor reads only the brief and the source material and writes the rubric (4–6 dimensions, 100 points, 95 is the bar) without ever seeing the draft. A tutor then meets it in one pass and may ask the professor what a criterion is for, never how to pass it. An independent reader scores it; the deliverable ships. No mechanical gate, no final/ directory. Four red lines outrank any score: fabricated numbers, opinion dressed as fact, two materials contradicting each other, promising what cannot be done.
